category.name: Data & Analytics
category.description: Careers focused on turning data into trustworthy evidence, decisions, reports, and analytical products.

career.title: Data Analyst
career.shortDescription: Turn raw organizational data into validated analyses, visualizations, dashboards, and recommendations for decision-makers.

skills.name: Analytical Thinking
skills.description: Frame questions, evaluate evidence, identify assumptions, and choose proportionate analytical approaches.

skills.name: Data Literacy
skills.description: Interpret data types, structures, measures, populations, samples, and common analytical claims.

skills.name: Business Analysis
skills.description: Translate organizational decisions and processes into analytical requirements and recommendations.

skills.name: Excel
skills.description: Analyze, validate, summarize, and present structured data in Microsoft Excel.

skills.name: SQL
skills.description: Query and transform relational data for analysis.

skills.name: Relational Databases
skills.description: Reason about schemas, tables, keys, relationships, grain, and normalized data.

skills.name: Descriptive Statistics
skills.description: Summarize distributions, center, spread, rates, and relationships accurately.

skills.name: Probability
skills.description: Reason about chance, conditional events, independence, and sampling variability.

skills.name: Inferential Statistics
skills.description: Estimate uncertainty and evaluate claims using samples.

skills.name: Regression
skills.description: Model and interpret relationships while checking assumptions and avoiding unsupported causal claims.

skills.name: Experimentation
skills.description: Design and analyze controlled experiments and A/B tests.

skills.name: Data Cleaning
skills.description: Diagnose and correct missing, invalid, duplicated, inconsistent, and malformed data.

skills.name: Data Wrangling
skills.description: Join, reshape, standardize, and prepare analysis-ready datasets.

skills.name: Data Quality
skills.description: Assess fitness for use and validate analytical inputs, transformations, and outputs.

skills.name: Data Ethics
skills.description: Recognize bias, misuse, conflicts, and responsibilities in analytical work.

skills.name: Data Privacy
skills.description: Handle personal and sensitive data using risk-aware lifecycle practices.

skills.name: Python
skills.description: Use Python to perform reproducible analytical work.

skills.name: pandas
skills.description: Load, clean, combine, reshape, summarize, and export tabular data with pandas.

skills.name: NumPy
skills.description: Use arrays and vectorized numerical operations in analytical workflows.

skills.name: Exploratory Data Analysis
skills.description: Systematically investigate distributions, relationships, segments, trends, and anomalies.

skills.name: Data Visualization
skills.description: Encode and present quantitative information clearly, honestly, and accessibly.

skills.name: Power BI
skills.description: Prepare, model, analyze, visualize, publish, and secure data in Power BI.

skills.name: Dashboards
skills.description: Design interactive, decision-oriented analytical reports and KPI experiences.

skills.name: Metrics and KPIs
skills.description: Define and analyze decision-relevant measures, targets, guardrails, funnels, and cohorts.

skills.name: Analytical Communication
skills.description: Explain evidence, implications, uncertainty, limitations, and recommendations for an audience.

skills.name: Git and GitHub
skills.description: Version, document, and publish reproducible analytical work.

skills.name: Forecasting
skills.description: Build, validate, and communicate practical time-series forecasts.

skills.name: Portfolio Development
skills.description: Present credible, well-documented evidence of analytical ability.

skills.name: Interview Preparation
skills.description: Demonstrate analytical judgment and technical competence in hiring processes.

courses.title: DA 101 — Data Analytics and Analytical Thinking
courses.shortDescription: Frame decision-oriented questions and learn the professional Data Analyst workflow.

lessons.title: The Data Analyst Role
lessons.summary: Distinguish Data Analyst responsibilities from data science, engineering, and software development.

lessons.title: Questions, Decisions, and Stakeholders
lessons.summary: Translate ambiguous requests into stakeholders, decisions, answerable questions, scope, and success criteria.

lessons.title: Data Structures, Types, and Grain
lessons.summary: Identify observations, variables, data types, tables, units, and levels of granularity.

lessons.title: Metrics, Dimensions, and Baselines
lessons.summary: Distinguish metrics, dimensions, targets, KPIs, comparison periods, and baselines.

lessons.title: The Analysis Lifecycle
lessons.summary: Plan the path from question and data acquisition through validation, analysis, communication, and action.

lessons.title: Reasoning Traps and Causal Caution
lessons.summary: Recognize selection effects, confounding, denominator errors, correlation-versus-causation, and overgeneralization.

lessons.title: Project Brief: Analysis Plan
lessons.summary: Turn an ambiguous business request into a one-page plan defining the decision, questions, population, measures, data needs, risks, and deliverable.

courses.title: DA 102 — Spreadsheet Analysis with Excel
courses.shortDescription: Use Excel to clean, calculate, validate, summarize, visualize, and audit business data.

lessons.title: Clean Tables and Spreadsheet Fundamentals
lessons.summary: Build rectangular tables with reliable field names, types, references, sorting, filtering, and named ranges.

lessons.title: Formulas and Conditional Logic
lessons.summary: Apply relative, absolute, and mixed references plus logical, conditional, arithmetic, and error-handling functions.

lessons.title: Text, Dates, and Lookups
lessons.summary: Transform text and dates and combine tables with modern lookup functions while checking unmatched keys.

lessons.title: Validation and Spreadsheet Auditing
lessons.summary: Detect blanks, duplicates, invalid values, formula inconsistencies, hidden assumptions, and fragile workbook design.

lessons.title: Pivot Tables and Business Summaries
lessons.summary: Create grouped summaries, pivot tables, calculated values, filters, and compact management views.

lessons.title: Charts and Power Query Introduction
lessons.summary: Build readable charts and import, type, standardize, and refresh data with foundational Power Query transformations.

lessons.title: Project Brief: Audited Sales Workbook
lessons.summary: Clean a messy workbook and deliver verified calculations, pivot summaries, charts, metric definitions, and a concise findings memo.

courses.title: DA 103 — Statistics and Probability Foundations
courses.shortDescription: Summarize variation and reason about probability and samples using practical analyst mathematics.

lessons.title: Measurement, Counts, Rates, and Change
lessons.summary: Work with units, variable types, proportions, rates, percentage change, weighted averages, and denominators.

lessons.title: Center, Spread, and Distribution Shape
lessons.summary: Calculate and interpret mean, median, quartiles, variance, standard deviation, skew, and outliers.

lessons.title: Percentiles and Standardized Values
lessons.summary: Compare observations with percentiles, interquartile ranges, and standardized scores.

lessons.title: Probability Fundamentals
lessons.summary: Calculate complements, combined events, conditional probability, and independence using business examples.

lessons.title: Populations, Samples, and Variability
lessons.summary: Distinguish populations, samples, parameters, statistics, sampling bias, and sampling variability.

lessons.title: Covariance, Correlation, and Interpretation
lessons.summary: Interpret direction and strength of relationships without treating correlation as causation.

lessons.title: Integrated Statistical Exercise Set
lessons.summary: Compute, select, and explain appropriate descriptive and probability results for one progressively analyzed dataset.

courses.title: DA 104 — Data Quality, Ethics, and Privacy
courses.shortDescription: Evaluate fitness for use and handle data with transparent, ethical, and privacy-aware practices.

lessons.title: Fitness for Use and Quality Dimensions
lessons.summary: Evaluate completeness, validity, consistency, uniqueness, accuracy, timeliness, and relevance.

lessons.title: Provenance, Lineage, Metadata, and Ownership
lessons.summary: Trace where data came from, how it changed, who owns it, and whether it supports the intended use.

lessons.title: Privacy Across the Data Lifecycle
lessons.summary: Identify personal and sensitive data and apply minimization, access, masking, retention, and safe-sharing principles.

lessons.title: Bias and Ethical Statistical Practice
lessons.summary: Recognize sampling, measurement, historical, algorithmic, analytical, and presentation bias.

lessons.title: Transparent Documentation and Responsible AI
lessons.summary: Document sources, transformations, exclusions, limitations, and human verification of AI-assisted work.

lessons.title: Project Brief: Data Risk Audit
lessons.summary: Audit a flawed dataset and proposed use, then specify corrections, prohibited uses, safeguards, and disclosures.

courses.title: DA 201 — SQL and Relational Data Analysis
courses.shortDescription: Query, combine, aggregate, validate, and explain relational business data with SQL.

lessons.title: Schemas, Tables, Keys, and Grain
lessons.summary: Reason about normalized schemas, primary and foreign keys, cardinality, and table grain.

lessons.title: Selecting, Filtering, Sorting, and Calculating
lessons.summary: Use SELECT, aliases, WHERE, ORDER BY, LIMIT, expressions, null handling, CASE, and common functions.

lessons.title: Aggregation and Grouped Analysis
lessons.summary: Build defensible grouped summaries using aggregate functions, GROUP BY, HAVING, and correct denominators.

lessons.title: Joins and Relationship Validation
lessons.summary: Write inner, left, and self joins and detect unmatched keys, duplication, and grain mismatches.

lessons.title: Subqueries and Common Table Expressions
lessons.summary: Decompose multi-step analytical logic into readable subqueries and CTEs.

lessons.title: Window Functions
lessons.summary: Calculate ranks, running totals, moving comparisons, shares, and prior-period values without collapsing rows.

lessons.title: Query Testing, Debugging, and Reuse
lessons.summary: Validate row counts and control totals, inspect edge cases, explain assumptions, and organize reusable queries.

lessons.title: Project Brief: Relational Business Investigation
lessons.summary: Analyze a normalized database and submit SQL scripts, validation evidence, a data dictionary, and findings memo.

courses.title: DA 202 — Data Cleaning and Wrangling
courses.shortDescription: Convert raw, inconsistent sources into validated analysis-ready data with a documented process.

lessons.title: Profiling Raw Data
lessons.summary: Inspect structure, types, domains, ranges, keys, distributions, and anomalies before changing data.

lessons.title: Missing, Invalid, and Inconsistent Values
lessons.summary: Diagnose missingness and standardize categories, text, dates, units, and invalid values defensibly.

lessons.title: Duplicates, Entities, and Repeated Events
lessons.summary: Resolve duplicate records without deleting legitimate repeated transactions or events.

lessons.title: Combining and Reconciling Sources
lessons.summary: Join and append sources while preserving grain, checking keys, and reconciling row counts and totals.

lessons.title: Reshaping and Outlier Investigation
lessons.summary: Pivot between wide and long structures and distinguish surprising valid observations from errors.

lessons.title: Validation Rules and Cleaning Logs
lessons.summary: Build repeatable assertions, quality measures, exception reports, and a transparent transformation log.

lessons.title: Project Brief: Analysis-Ready Dataset
lessons.summary: Integrate inconsistent source files and deliver clean data, before-and-after quality measures, and a reproducible cleaning log.

courses.title: DA 203 — Python for Data Analysis
courses.shortDescription: Use Python, NumPy, pandas, notebooks, and GitHub for reproducible tabular analysis.

lessons.title: Python and Notebook Workflow
lessons.summary: Use notebooks and scripts with values, types, collections, conditionals, loops, imports, and readable execution order.

lessons.title: Functions, Errors, and Validation
lessons.summary: Create reusable transformations, handle common exceptions, debug failures, and assert expected results.

lessons.title: NumPy and Vectorized Analysis
lessons.summary: Create arrays, select values, calculate summaries, and replace slow element-by-element operations with vectorization.

lessons.title: pandas DataFrames and Data Input
lessons.summary: Load common formats and select, filter, sort, type, index, and export DataFrames.

lessons.title: Grouping, Aggregation, and Reshaping
lessons.summary: Group, aggregate, merge, concatenate, pivot, melt, and validate tabular data.

lessons.title: Cleaning Dates, Text, Categories, and Missing Data
lessons.summary: Build repeatable pandas transformations for common messy-data conditions.

lessons.title: Reproducible Repositories with Git and GitHub
lessons.summary: Organize files, environments, commits, README documentation, outputs, and data exclusions for reviewable work.

lessons.title: Project Brief: Reproducible Analysis Notebook
lessons.summary: Import, clean, validate, analyze, and export a dataset in a documented notebook repository.

courses.title: DA 204 — Exploratory Analysis and Data Visualization
courses.shortDescription: Explore patterns systematically and create clear, honest, accessible explanatory visualizations.

lessons.title: A Structured EDA Workflow
lessons.summary: Move from data audit and hypotheses through univariate, bivariate, multivariate, and segmented exploration.

lessons.title: Distributions, Groups, and Relationships
lessons.summary: Investigate center, spread, shape, category differences, association, nonlinearity, and confounding candidates.

lessons.title: Time, Missingness, and Anomalies
lessons.summary: Explore trends, seasonality, gaps, changing coverage, missingness patterns, and unusual observations.

lessons.title: Chart Selection and Visual Perception
lessons.summary: Choose encodings based on purpose and apply perceptual hierarchy, comparison, and cognitive-load principles.

lessons.title: Truthful and Accessible Visualization
lessons.summary: Use scales, baselines, denominators, color, labeling, annotation, and accessibility without misleading the audience.

lessons.title: Exploratory versus Explanatory Graphics
lessons.summary: Select evidence from broad exploration and revise it into focused stakeholder-facing graphics.

lessons.title: Project Brief: Five-Chart Visual Analysis
lessons.summary: Deliver an EDA notebook and five-chart explanatory report with findings, limitations, and unresolved questions.

courses.title: DA 205 — Business Intelligence and Dashboard Design
courses.shortDescription: Prepare, model, analyze, visualize, publish, and validate decision-oriented Power BI reports.

lessons.title: BI Architecture and Data Connections
lessons.summary: Connect to files, databases, and semantic models and distinguish import, live, refresh, and ownership concerns.

lessons.title: Power Query Preparation
lessons.summary: Profile, type, filter, combine, reshape, parameterize, and validate source data.

lessons.title: Facts, Dimensions, and Star Schemas
lessons.summary: Declare grain and build date tables, dimensions, facts, relationships, and filter paths.

lessons.title: Measures, DAX, and Time Intelligence
lessons.summary: Distinguish measures from calculated columns and implement aggregations, CALCULATE, ratios, and period comparisons.

lessons.title: Interactive Report and KPI Design
lessons.summary: Build decision-focused pages with targets, context, filters, drill-through, tooltips, navigation, and mobile layout.

lessons.title: Accessibility, Performance, Publishing, and Security
lessons.summary: Test usability and performance and apply workspace, refresh, permissions, sensitivity, and row-level-security concepts.

lessons.title: Tableau Concepts Comparison Lab
lessons.summary: Recreate a small analytical view in Tableau and map connections, fields, calculations, sheets, filters, and dashboards across tools.

lessons.title: Project Brief: Operational BI Dashboard
lessons.summary: Build and present an interactive dashboard with a documented model, metric definitions, validation evidence, and executive summary.

courses.title: DA 301 — Applied Statistical Inference
courses.shortDescription: Estimate uncertainty and evaluate sample-based claims with appropriately qualified conclusions.

lessons.title: Sampling Designs, Bias, and Generalization
lessons.summary: Evaluate random, stratified, clustered, convenience, and observational samples and define defensible target populations.

lessons.title: Sampling Distributions and Standard Error
lessons.summary: Explain how sample statistics vary and calculate or simulate standard errors.

lessons.title: Confidence Intervals
lessons.summary: Construct and correctly interpret intervals for common means, proportions, and differences.

lessons.title: Hypothesis Tests for Means and Proportions
lessons.summary: Form hypotheses, select tests, interpret p-values, and report effect size and practical significance.

lessons.title: Categorical Association and Alternatives
lessons.summary: Evaluate categorical association and select nonparametric alternatives when assumptions are not credible.

lessons.title: Power, Error Rates, and Multiple Testing
lessons.summary: Reason about Type I and II errors, sample size, power, repeated testing, and selective reporting.

lessons.title: Project Brief: Evidence and Uncertainty Memo
lessons.summary: Evaluate a sample-based claim with reproducible calculations, assumptions, effect size, uncertainty, and an executive interpretation.

courses.title: DA 302 — Business Analytics, Metrics, and KPIs
courses.shortDescription: Define decision-relevant metrics and analyze business performance, funnels, cohorts, and drivers.

lessons.title: Processes, Decisions, and Requirements
lessons.summary: Map business processes and data-generating events and document stakeholder decisions and analytical requirements.

lessons.title: Metric Contracts, Targets, and Guardrails
lessons.summary: Write unambiguous definitions covering population, formula, grain, exclusions, timing, owner, targets, and guardrails.

lessons.title: Revenue, Cost, Margin, and Unit Economics
lessons.summary: Calculate and reconcile core financial and per-unit operating measures without becoming a finance-specialist course.

lessons.title: Funnels, Cohorts, Retention, and Churn
lessons.summary: Define eligible populations and analyze conversion stages, cohorts, retention curves, and churn.

lessons.title: Operations Metrics and Driver Trees
lessons.summary: Analyze throughput, service, quality, capacity, variance, and decomposed outcome drivers.

lessons.title: Leading, Lagging, and Dangerous Metrics
lessons.summary: Distinguish leading, lagging, diagnostic, vanity, and incentive-distorting measures.

lessons.title: Project Brief: Measurement Framework
lessons.summary: Design and implement a KPI framework for a product, service, or operation using transactional data.

courses.title: DA 303 — Regression and Experimentation
courses.shortDescription: Model relationships and design and analyze controlled experiments without overstating causality.

lessons.title: Simple and Multiple Linear Regression
lessons.summary: Fit and interpret regression coefficients, uncertainty, predictions, and model fit in business context.

lessons.title: Categories, Interactions, and Diagnostics
lessons.summary: Encode categories, interpret interactions, inspect residuals, and identify influential observations and assumption problems.

lessons.title: Prediction, Explanation, and Causal Limits
lessons.summary: Distinguish analytical goals and recognize confounding, omitted variables, reverse causality, and overfitting.

lessons.title: Experiment Design
lessons.summary: Define hypotheses, units, eligibility, randomization, treatment, control, exposure, primary metrics, and guardrails.

lessons.title: Power and A/B Test Analysis
lessons.summary: Plan sample size and analyze differences with effect sizes, confidence intervals, and decision thresholds.

lessons.title: Experiment Failure Modes
lessons.summary: Detect peeking, multiple comparisons, sample-ratio mismatch, contamination, novelty, attrition, and instrumentation failures.

lessons.title: Project Brief: Experiment Recommendation
lessons.summary: Analyze an experiment or carefully framed observational study and recommend launch, iteration, or further investigation.

courses.title: DA 304 — Communicating Insights and Analytical Storytelling
courses.shortDescription: Turn technical results into honest, audience-specific narratives, recommendations, and presentations.

lessons.title: Audience, Decision, and Message
lessons.summary: Adapt depth, language, evidence, and format for executive, operational, and technical audiences.

lessons.title: Finding, Insight, Implication, and Recommendation
lessons.summary: Separate what the data shows from interpretation, consequence, proposed action, and decision ownership.

lessons.title: Executive Summaries and Analytical Memos
lessons.summary: Write concise documents organized around context, evidence, implication, action, and limitations.

lessons.title: Presentation and Explanatory Visual Design
lessons.summary: Create slides, annotations, visual hierarchy, and spoken explanations that focus attention without distorting evidence.

lessons.title: Uncertainty, Limitations, and Objections
lessons.summary: Explain caveats clearly, answer skeptical questions, distinguish unknown from unknowable, and propose next steps.

lessons.title: Requirements Meetings and Feedback
lessons.summary: Practice active listening, clarification, acceptance criteria, readouts, and evidence-preserving revision.

lessons.title: Project Brief: Three-Audience Analysis
lessons.summary: Convert one analysis into an executive brief, short presentation, and technical appendix, then answer questions live or by recording.

courses.title: DA 351 — Analytics in a Business Domain
courses.shortDescription: Develop contextual judgment through a focused product, marketing, operations, finance, people, public-sector, or healthcare case.

lessons.title: Select a Domain and Map Its Decisions
lessons.summary: Choose product, marketing, operations, finance, people, public-sector, or healthcare analytics and map its actors, processes, and decisions.

lessons.title: Domain Entities, Events, and Metrics
lessons.summary: Define the domain vocabulary, data model, event lifecycle, key measures, comparison groups, and benchmarks.

lessons.title: Domain Data Risks and Constraints
lessons.summary: Identify context-specific quality, privacy, compliance, equity, seasonality, and decision constraints.

lessons.title: Domain Case Analysis
lessons.summary: Analyze a representative dataset using the measures and methods appropriate to the selected domain.

lessons.title: Stakeholder Interpretation
lessons.summary: Explain how domain knowledge changes interpretation, limitations, recommendations, and the cost of error.

lessons.title: Project Brief: Domain Portfolio Case
lessons.summary: Deliver a stakeholder-ready domain analysis suitable for a specialized portfolio.

courses.title: DA 352 — Forecasting and Time-Series Fundamentals
courses.shortDescription: Build and backtest practical forecasts while communicating uncertainty and operational limitations.

lessons.title: Time-Series Structure and Temporal Grain
lessons.summary: Identify time index, frequency, aggregation, trend, seasonality, cycles, calendar effects, gaps, and irregular variation.

lessons.title: Visualization and Baseline Forecasts
lessons.summary: Explore series and establish naïve, seasonal-naïve, and moving-average baselines.

lessons.title: Smoothing and Time-Feature Models
lessons.summary: Apply exponential smoothing and simple regression with calendar and trend features.

lessons.title: Backtesting and Forecast Error
lessons.summary: Use chronological splits and rolling validation and compare appropriate scale-dependent and percentage error metrics.

lessons.title: Intervals, Leakage, Scenarios, and Risk
lessons.summary: Interpret prediction intervals, prevent future-data leakage, and distinguish forecasts from scenarios and targets.

lessons.title: Project Brief: Backtested Business Forecast
lessons.summary: Forecast a business measure, beat or explain failure to beat simple baselines, and communicate when the result should not be trusted.

courses.title: DA 401 — Applied Data Analyst Case Lab
courses.shortDescription: Solve varied, ambiguous analyst cases under realistic constraints and revise work through review.

lessons.title: Case Intake, Scoping, and Tool Choice
lessons.summary: Scope unfamiliar requests, define minimum defensible work, and choose Excel, SQL, Python, or BI based on the problem.

lessons.title: Spreadsheet Audit Case
lessons.summary: Find formula, data, logic, and presentation defects in a decision-critical workbook and issue a corrected version.

lessons.title: SQL Investigation Case
lessons.summary: Inspect an unfamiliar schema, validate grain, answer stakeholder questions, and deliver traceable queries.

lessons.title: Python Cleaning and EDA Case
lessons.summary: Repair and explore imperfect multi-file data in a reproducible notebook under a defined deadline.

lessons.title: KPI and Dashboard Case
lessons.summary: Resolve ambiguous metrics and deliver a validated decision-oriented dashboard slice.

lessons.title: Statistical Evidence Case
lessons.summary: Select and apply a proportionate inferential method and communicate uncertainty without overstating evidence.

lessons.title: Peer Review, Revision, and Oral Defense
lessons.summary: Review another analysis, respond to feedback, repair defects, and defend major choices and limitations.

courses.title: DA 402 — Data Analyst Capstone
courses.shortDescription: Complete and defend an independent, reproducible, end-to-end analysis using raw or minimally prepared data.

lessons.title: Proposal, Stakeholder, and Analysis Plan
lessons.summary: Select a decision-oriented problem and define stakeholder, questions, scope, measures, success criteria, milestones, and deliverables.

lessons.title: Source, Ethics, Privacy, and Quality Review
lessons.summary: Document provenance, licenses, population, grain, access, fitness for use, bias, privacy, limitations, and a mitigation plan.

lessons.title: Acquisition, Cleaning, Integration, and Validation
lessons.summary: Use SQL and Python where appropriate to produce analysis-ready data with transformations, assertions, reconciliation, and a data dictionary.

lessons.title: Exploratory and Statistical Analysis
lessons.summary: Explore the evidence and apply descriptive and inferential methods proportionate to the question.

lessons.title: Dashboard or Explanatory Visual Product
lessons.summary: Build a validated dashboard or polished visual report aligned to the stakeholder's recurring or one-time decision.

lessons.title: Reproducibility and Independent Review
lessons.summary: Package code, queries, data instructions, dependencies, outputs, and decision logs so another analyst can review the work.

lessons.title: Report, Executive Summary, and Recommendation
lessons.summary: Write evidence, implications, recommended action, uncertainty, assumptions, limitations, and proposed follow-up.

lessons.title: Final Presentation, Defense, and Revision
lessons.summary: Present to a mixed audience, answer challenges, document feedback, and publish a corrected final version.

courses.title: DA 403 — Portfolio, Interviews, and Career Practice
courses.shortDescription: Publish credible evidence of analyst ability and prepare for practical, technical, and stakeholder interviews.

lessons.title: Credible Portfolio Evidence
lessons.summary: Select complementary work that demonstrates question framing, SQL, cleaning, statistics, visualization, and communication.

lessons.title: Case Studies and Repository Presentation
lessons.summary: Write decision-centered project summaries and publish readable repositories, notebooks, dashboards, methods, and results.

lessons.title: Publication Safety and Professional Materials
lessons.summary: Remove sensitive data, document licenses and attribution, and build a role-aligned resume and professional profile.

lessons.title: SQL, Spreadsheet, and Statistics Interviews
lessons.summary: Practice query, workbook, probability, inference, and interpretation tasks while explaining reasoning aloud.

lessons.title: Metrics, Dashboard, and Business Cases
lessons.summary: Define metrics, critique analytical products, scope ambiguous cases, and recommend evidence-based actions.

lessons.title: Project Presentation and Behavioral Interview
lessons.summary: Explain contributions, choices, errors, feedback, conflict, limitations, and outcomes using concise examples.

lessons.title: Project Brief: Career-Ready Portfolio
lessons.summary: Publish at least three polished analytical artifacts, complete a mock interview, and create a targeted application and skill-gap plan.

pathway.name: Data Analyst Career Pathway
pathway.description: A job-focused pathway from data literacy through independent analysis, dashboards, statistical reasoning, stakeholder communication, and portfolio evidence. Advanced machine learning and data engineering are intentionally outside the core.

levels.name: 100 Level — Foundations
levels.description: Build data literacy, spreadsheet fluency, quantitative foundations, and responsible data-handling habits.

levels.name: 200 Level — Core Analyst Skills
levels.description: Develop the junior analyst toolkit: SQL, relational data, cleaning, Python, exploration, visualization, and BI dashboards.

levels.name: 300 Level — Professional Data Analysis
levels.description: Apply statistical inference, business metrics, experiments, regression, and stakeholder communication, with optional domain depth.

levels.name: 400 Level — Career Ready
levels.description: Demonstrate independent end-to-end analysis through realistic cases, a signature capstone, a portfolio, and interview practice.
